props.name: variant
size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional Input label above the field; when set it also names the input.

props.name: leading
props.description: Replaces the search icon: an icon name (`"icon-filter-lines-line"`, sized to the field) or any node.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Replaces the whole trailing group (clear button, shortcut, filter): an icon name (sized to the field) or any node.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows the Figma Inputted clear affordance when the field has a value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text on every change, and with "" when the clear button empties the field.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What is searched ("Search members"); also the accessible name without `label`/`aria-label`. Default: the locale's "Search".

props.name: filterLabel
props.description: Label paired with the chevron in the Filter-Dropdown variant. Default: the locale's "All".

props.name: filterInteractive
props.description: Filter-Icon / Filter-Dropdown trailing is an `InputLeadingTrailing`: clickable by default, `false` makes it decorative.

props.name: onFilterClick
props.description: Action for the filter affordance (e.g. open a filter panel or your own menu).

props.name: filterHasPopup
props.description:
`aria-haspopup` of the filter affordance when `onFilterClick` opens your own surface: `"dialog"` for a Bottom Sheet,
 Side Panel or Modal, `"menu"` or `"listbox"` for a menu or Popover list. Filter-Dropdown with `filterOptions`
 manages its own listbox and ignores it. (`aria-haspopup` on Search itself goes to the input.)

props.name: filterExpanded
props.description: `aria-expanded` of that filter affordance: whether the surface it opens is open now. Pair it with `filterHasPopup`.

props.name: filterOptions
props.description: Filter-Dropdown picker: options open the shared Popover and replace `filterLabel` with the selected label.

props.name: filterActionLabel
props.description: Accessible name / Popover heading for the filter affordance. Default: the locale's "Filter".

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Search/Default is a `.Primitives/Input/Field-Only` instance, so Disabled is Field-Only State=Disabled
(Input/Border/Disabled, Content/Disabled text) with its Leading/Trailing at Active=No. The clear button and the
shortcut hint are hidden and the filter is locked. Use it when searching is unavailable for a reason the page shows.

props.name: shortcut
props.description:
Keyboard shortcut key shown as `⌘K` in the trailing slot (Figma Side-Bar Small-Density search); pressing
⌘/Ctrl + key focuses the field. Hidden while the field has a value (the clear button takes the slot).

types.InputLeadingTrailingOption: type InputLeadingTrailingOption = { value: string; label: ReactNode; caption?: ReactNode; icon?: IconName | ReactNode; flag?: ReactNode; }
